question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH whsle_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        CAST(SUBSTR(vwd.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        ROUND(AVG(vwd."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(vwd."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as max_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MIN(vwd."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(vwd."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(vwd."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
        ROUND(SUM(vwd."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df vwd
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vwd.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(vwd.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, CAST(SUBSTR(vwd.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
txn_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        CAST(SUBSTR(vtd.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        ROUND(SUM(vtd."qty_sold(kg)" * vtd."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg"), 2) as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df vtd
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vtd.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(vtd.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, CAST(SUBSTR(vtd.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
loss_by_item AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        vl.item_code,
        ROUND(AVG(vl."loss_rate_%"), 2) as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df vl
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vl.item_code = vc.item_code
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, vl.item_code
),
loss_by_category AS (
    SELECT 
        category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_loss_rate), 2) as avg_loss_rate
    FROM loss_by_item
    GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT 
    whsle_agg.category_name,
    whsle_agg.year,
    whsle_agg.avg_wholesale_price,
    whsle_agg.max_wholesale_price,
    whsle_agg.min_wholesale_price,
    whsle_agg.wholesale_price_difference,
    whsle_agg.total_wholesale_price,
    COALESCE(txn_agg.total_selling_price, 0) as total_selling_price,
    COALESCE(loss_cat.avg_loss_rate, 0) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(COALESCE(txn_agg.total_selling_price, 0) * COALESCE(loss_cat.avg_loss_rate, 0) / 100, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(COALESCE(txn_agg.total_selling_price, 0) - ROUND(COALESCE(txn_agg.total_selling_price, 0) * COALESCE(loss_cat.avg_loss_rate, 0) / 100, 2), 2) as profit
FROM whsle_agg
LEFT JOIN txn_agg ON whsle_agg.category_name = txn_agg.category_name AND whsle_agg.year = txn_agg.year
LEFT JOIN loss_by_category loss_cat ON whsle_agg.category_name = loss_cat.category_name
ORDER BY whsle_agg.category_name, whsle_agg.year
